summary.text: Michelle Mussman has represented the 56th District in the Illinois House of Representatives since January 2011.

paragraphs.text: Mussman holds a B.S. in design from the University of Cincinnati.
The legislature biography lists Mussman as a board member of Women In Need Growing Stronger (WINGS) and the Children's Advocacy Center of North and Northwest Cook County.
